title: RCAT PDF HUB future completed-job output manifest (planning only)
description: Non-runtime proposal. Only completed jobs may yield output manifests. No signed URLs, stored object keys, filesystem paths or embedded content; downloads require independent owner and file checks.

file_name.description: Display-only safe basename. No path separators/control chars; never used as a filesystem path.

x-contract-safety: Job owner requested_by and every artifact source_system must match before creating or listing a result manifest.
Every file_id is a previously stored FileRecord associated with this job; never trust client-supplied IDs.
Manifest file_name is display-only; never store stored_name, signed URLs or arbitrary filesystem paths.
Authorize every artifact download via existing authenticated file endpoint and expiry checks; never authorize solely by manifest membership.
No manifest for queued/running/failed/cancelled jobs; partial writes must be rolled back or GC cleaned.
The primary artifact must exist; bundle output is optional and must not weaken individual-file ownership.
Quota counts total bytes of all persisted artifacts (including bundle); scan each stored artifact; prevent zip bombs in generated/composed archives.
Expiry is independently verified at download; explicitly retained files may have null expires_at.
